description:
Here is the merged, chronological description of the video frames, with redundancy removed and the sequence logically ordered:

---

The video begins with a blue banner in the top-left corner displaying the **Red Bull** logo, followed by the word **"BOXING"** in the same area. Near the center of the banner, the number **"11"** is visible. In the top-right corner of the banner, the text **"MOM"** appears.

A **Monster Energy** can is prominently featured, with multiple nutritional and volume details visible on its label, including:
- **"MONSTER"**
- **"355 mL"**
- **"2.25"**
- **"24.5"**
- **"237"**
- **"16.9"**
- **"1"**
- **"REBEL"**

The scene transitions to a central display where the word **"BOXER"** is shown, followed by the numbers **"902"** and **"978"**. To the right, a countdown appears with the numbers **"1000"**, **"900"**, **"800"**, **"700"**, **"600"**, **"500"**, **"400"**, **"300"**, **"200"**, and **"100"**.

In the top-right corner, a blurry text reads **"9 3/4"**. On an arcade machine, the words **"MIGHTY MONSTERS"** are displayed in the center-right, while **"1"** appears in the center-left.

Further into the sequence, the number **"2"** appears mid-right, followed by the **Red Bull** logo again at the top-center. The word **"BOXER"** is visible mid-left, with the numbers **"902"** and **"978"** at the bottom-left.
